remarks: Welcome home to your cozy gem on the brim of downtown Stamford! This large studio offers an updated kitchen with new appliances, full bath with tub, fabulous private balcony & one assigned off street parking space. Included in the rent is: hot water, heat up to 55 degrees, one reserved parking. Community laundry in the building. Convenient to all major routes and amenities ~ shops, restaurants nearby. Spacious, sun-filled, light and bright ~ move in, unpack and enjoy the vibes of City life! Photos prior to current occupant.
